render_stylegan_image: render a StyleGAN image from a pkl checkpoint with specified truncation psi and random seed
run_synthesis_network: run the synthesis network with hooks to capture intermediate layer activations and outputs
apply_affine_transformation: apply an affine transformation to a tensor using a bandlimited Lanczos filter and grid sampling
construct_affine_bandlimit_filter: construct a 2D windowed FIR bandlimit filter from an affine transformation matrix for resampling
get_camera_trajectory: get a camera trajectory tensor for a given generator with specified pitch, yaw, and fov parameters
